body:
Jason Scott Rosen is a worldbuilding creative project director, experience producer, emergent technologies strategist, and business leader — fluent across transmedia arts and narrative technologies in equal measure.

Based across Atlanta, New York, Seattle, and Los Angeles, he steers complex multi-phase productions through to launch, leading cross-functional teams for some of the world's most prominent brands, organizations, and institutions.

He consults and directs at the executive level across immersive, interactive, digital, experiential, entertainment, attraction, product, and live production — pushing innovation at the convergence of media, arts, brand, and communication technologies.
